test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) to the office

(B) reached

(C) Mr. Sharma

(D) at 9 am
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **CBAD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject, **Mr. Sharma**, which is correctly indicated by part **(C).**
 
• Following the subject, **reached** **(B)** logically continues the sentence, indicating the action performed by Mr. Sharma.
 
• **The next part,** **to the office** (A), completes the object of the action, specifying where Mr. Sharma reached.
 
• **Ending with** **at 9 am** (D), the sentence is completed with the time detail.

Therefore, the correct sequence is **CBAD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (CABD):** This option starts with **Mr. Sharma to the office reached at 9 am.** This structure is incorrect as the verb *reached* is placed in the wrong position.
 
• **Option 2 (CDBA):** This option starts with **Mr. Sharma at 9 am reached to the office.** This sequence disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (DCAB):** This option starts with **at 9 am Mr. Sharma to the office reached.** This structure is grammatically incorrect and confusing.
